deviceId.meaning: ID of a PJLink device declared in the carapace profile; HTTP defaults a missing or non-string value to the empty string.

state.meaning: Requested power state; missing or non-string HTTP value becomes an empty string.

dryRun.meaning: When true, return the planned power command without a projector exchange or receipt-store write; omitted or non-boolean HTTP values default to false.

ok.meaning: Whether the power reply matched the expected response.

command.meaning: PJLink command or validation failure command.

requestedState.meaning: Requested state, or null for a power query.

mutation.meaning: Whether a power mutation was sent, not a receipt-store write.

dryRun.meaning: Whether the operation was a dry run.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. Open forms can also appear: caduceus-pjlink-device-invalid:<serde error>, caduceus-pjlink-resolve-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-connect-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-read-timeout-set-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-write-timeout-set-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-stream-clone-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-greeting-read-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-write-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-flush-failed:<OS error>, caduceus-pjlink-response-read-failed:<OS error> and caduceus-pjlink-receipt-invalid:<serialization error>.
